title: What the Lord Requires of Israel
description: Moses reminds Israel that he stood on the mountain for forty days and forty nights, and that the Lord heard him so that the people were not destroyed. Then he proclaims what the Lord requires: to fear Him, walk in all His ways, love and serve Him with all your heart and soul, and keep His commands. The Lord chose their fathers and their descendants above all peoples. The people are to circumcise the foreskin of their hearts, not be stiff-necked, and love the foreigner as they themselves were foreigners in Egypt. With seventy souls the fathers went down to Egypt, and now the Lord has made them numerous as the stars of heaven.
